title_candidates: Claude for Teachers gives US educators a free year
Teachers can now try Claude's classroom tools free
summary: Verified US K-12 educators can claim a free year of Claude with classroom-focused tools, privacy protections, and standards-linked planning support.

primary_source.title: Introducing Claude for Teachers
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Verified US K-12 educators can receive one year of premium Claude access at no cost if they register by June 30, 2027.
The offer includes teaching-specific skills and a Learning Commons connector with standards from all 50 states.
Teachers can use the tools for lesson planning, differentiated materials, class-data analysis, and recurring work such as reviewing exit tickets.
Anthropic says teacher inputs and outputs are not used for model training, and its K-12 data terms are designed around FERPA requirements.
Claude for Teachers is for adults working in education, not student-facing accounts, and a separate school-and-district product is planned.
The package includes Claude Code and Cowork plus integrations with several K-12 education tools.

quote_candidates.text: You control what data is shared; nothing you share is used in model training.
quote_candidates.position: How it works, Analyze class data

supporting_sources.title: Claude for Teachers: your data and our terms
key_facts: Anthropic's help page explains eligibility, included features, data handling, and the registration deadline.

supporting_sources.title: Getting started with Claude for Teachers
key_facts: Anthropic provides an official educator verification and onboarding walkthrough.

prerequisites: Age 18 or older and employment at a US K-12 school or district
A professional school email and affiliation proof if requested
A lesson topic and standard; no identifiable student data

steps.instruction: Check Anthropic's eligibility page and confirm that your school role and location qualify.
Open Claude for Teachers, select 'Get verified,' and sign in with your professional school email.
Complete the Goodstack verification prompts and check the status in Claude Settings.
After approval, refresh Claude and complete the educator onboarding.
Without student information, ask for a grade-, subject-, and standards-specific formative assessment with two difficulty levels and an answer key; review every item before use.
